helpers.apiAddress: Select from common providers or enter any OpenAl-compatible base URL
helpers.modelName: If list fetch fails, enter model name manually
helpers.vision: Enable model vision capability. Turn on only for models that really accept image input; enabling it on a text-only model makes every round fail upstream.
helpers.cot: Enable NA-provided Chain of Thought. Disable if model supports native CoT.
helpers.prefillMode: Turn this on only when the service really treats a trailing assistant message as the start of the reply. If the provider rejects it, the prefill is removed and the request retried once, and this group stops sending prefill for a while.
helpers.apiFormat: With Gemini native, enter the API base URL up to the version, e.g. https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta; native parameters such as thinking budget and safety thresholds go in the extra request body's generationConfig / safetySettings.
helpers.contextLength: Enter this model's real context window. The per-round worldbook budget is a percentage of it; 0 means unset and is estimated at 32768. A larger value injects more worldbook content and costs more
helpers.tokenCountFactor: How many or how few tokens this model's tokenizer produces compared with o200k_base; 0 means infer from the model name (DeepSeek 0.80, Gemini 0.89, Qwen 0.90, Claude 1.29, etc.)
helpers.budgetEstimate: With the global settings, the worldbook is capped at about {{budget}} tokens per round (about {{approx}} chars)
helpers.budgetEstimateAutoFactor: (token factor inferred from the model name)
helpers.smallContext: The context length is only {{contextLength}}, no more than the worldbook output reserve of {{outputReserve}}: with this group the worldbook budget is 1 token per round, so no entry can be injected. This field is a token count; enter 0 if unsure (estimated at 32768)
helpers.nameCopy: Set a new name for the copied group
helpers.nameChar: Chinese, letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation (e.g. - _ . ( ) : （ ） 【 】 、 ·); up to 64 characters. Cannot change after creation.
helpers.fetchPrecondition: Fill API Address and Key first
helpers.presencePenalty: Penalty for new tokens based on their presence in the text so far (-2 to 2)
helpers.frequencyPenalty: Penalty for new tokens based on their frequency in the text so far (-2 to 2)
helpers.credentialHidden: This model group is maintained by the platform. The value shown is a mask, not the real credential; saving keeps the existing credential untouched.
helpers.apiKeyKeep: Leave it untouched to keep the current credential; type a new value to replace it.
helpers.visibilityShared: Tenants can select this model group in their own console, but never see its credential or endpoint
helpers.visibilityPrivate: Only the platform can see and use it; it never appears in a tenant's list
